environment.description: Same Go binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to BLOCK at threshold 2048 bytes, and (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string component that uses the pattern '(?i)(\\d+\\s*(;|--|\\/\\*|union|select|pg_sleep|extract|cast|chr\\())' with action BLOCK and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the RDS PostgreSQL instance has a restricted search_path set via parameter group (search_path='"$user",public' with rds.restrict_privileged_commands=1) and the application database role has NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, and is granted SELECT-only on the products table via: GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_reader; REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM app_reader; GRANT SELECT ON products TO app_reader;

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, SG allows only ALB->8080
